messages:
sam: FYI nightly SAST spiked with 120 new findings on repo `payments-shared`. Most look like generated protobufs flagged as 'unsafe-deserialization'. Breaking pre-merge gate and blocking 5 PRs.

viv: ugh. did we change the proto generator or the linter rules?

sam: We merged the proto cleanup yesterday (PR #2011) that moved files into `gen/` and added a few custom deserializers. Scanners don't exclude `gen/`.

carla: We should avoid blanket suppressions. Per suppression policy, any blanket fp suppression needs security review & audit trail.

security-bot: audit-event: 2026-04-10T02:03:12Z findings_increase repo=payments-shared delta=+120 triggered-by=ci-sast-nightly. See http://internal/audit/ev/11021

oncall: This is impacting releases. Owners need unblock path. Proposal: auto-create an evidence ticket for each PR with the stacktrace and the file path, mark PR as `scan:fp-review` (soft-block) and send to `eng-sre` + `owners`. That way merges pause but dev flow is explicit.

viv: ok, but also: add a short-term scanner rule tweak to exclude `gen/` by path and signature pattern, but only after security signs off. We can add a conditional suppression that expires in 7 days.

carla: To get security sign-off we need: repro steps, sample failing file, why it's FP (generator-only), and acceptance tests proving sanitizer behavior. Also need an auditor entry with approver and duration.

sam: I'll auto-generate the artifact bundle from the failing runs and attach to ticket. Will include minimal repro and quick unit that asserts safe-deserialize path.

oncall: Suggest RBAC note: temporary suppression changes should be implemented via `sast-config` repo with PR and `SECURITY_APPROVED` label rather than direct scanner config edits. That preserves audit and CI enforces the label before applying ephemeral suppressions.

carla: Good. Also add an alert to `eng-sre` if similar find-rate spikes >50/hour so oncall can triage before mass-blocking.

security-bot: audit-event: 2026-04-10T02:15:01Z suppression_request created repo=payments-shared by sam ticket=INT-6001

viv: I'll open the PR to `sast-config` with path-exclude + TTL 7d and link INT-6001. Please include the sample tests.

sam: PR opened: sast-config#487. Added `SECURITY_APPROVED: pending` and a checklist in the PR body.

carla: I'll review the artifact and sign off if tests look good. If approved, we record approver, justification, and expiration timestamp in the audit ticket.

oncall: For longer-term fix, add generator signature heuristics into scanner (hash of generator comment block) and a unit in nightly to detect regressions. Also weave this check into the pre-merge `ci-access-check` so PRs touching `gen/*` run additional signer tests.

viv: agree. Also add a step to run `scripts/scan-keystore-access-check.sh` for CI SAs when introducing RBAC or infra PRs that touch scanner config. That avoids the KMS/RBAC surprise we had last month.

security-bot: audit-event: 2026-04-10T02:44:00Z suppression_approved approver=carla ticket=INT-6001 expires=2026-04-17T02:44:00Z

carla: Approved with condition: implement generator-heuristic rule + tests in 3 days or revert suppression early.

viv: noted. I'll start the scanner heuristic RFC and the `gen/` detection patch.

sam: Action items:
- sam: attach failing artifacts to INT-6001 + add quick unit repro [ETA: 1h]
- viv: PR to sast-config with conditional path-exclude TTL 7d (open) [ETA: now]
- carla: review artifacts and approve suppression if tests pass [ETA: 3h]
- oncall: add spike alert to eng-sre and add `gen/` post-merge check to pre-merge flow [ETA: 24h]

sam: closing thread for now, followups tracked in INT-6001 and sast-config#487. Ping me if anything critical pops up.
